set.body: Acceptance criteria: DetectionResult carries the exact full AlgorithmCard or an explicitly weaker custom identity and tidy export consumes that identity rather than a separately supplied card; arbitrary DetectorRef plus Machine cannot forge scientific metadata; Engbert-Kliegl irregular-sampling failures remain named values instead of becoming empty movement; detection duration accounting carries an explicit TemporalSupport policy consistent with exported unclassified time; configuration and conformance tests cover all paths.
set.title: Bind detector identity, preparation, and temporal accounting
